turns.customer: My Traverse 65 pack (order #1336) got lost in the mail. I want my money back and a 25% off coupon for the trouble.
turns.reply:
Sorry to hear your pack was lost in transit. I've looked into order #1336 — the carrier declared the Traverse 65 Trekking Pack lost on 09/02.

Refund: A $259.00 refund request has been sent to a team member for approval and will usually be reviewed within one business day. No money has been returned yet.

Coupon: I can issue a one-time coupon, but the maximum I'm able to give is 10% (not 25%). Yours is ready to use: code SORRY-13-20260915, good for 10% off, single use, expires 12/14/2026.

Thanks for your patience while this is sorted out.
